findings: The company reports utilizing its core patented technological platforms, the rice endosperm specific expression platform (OryzHiExp) and the protein high purification platform (OryzPur), to develop high-efficiency and high-purity recombinant human lactoferrin (OsrhLF).

The company reports that its recombinant human lactoferrin has a purity of more than 95% as determined by SDS-PAGE, possesses an endotoxin level of less than 1EU/mg, and can be manufactured at hundreds of kilograms scales.

The rating rests on the company's clear capability to manufacture recombinant human lactoferrin using its proprietary OryzHiExp expression and OryzPur purification platforms, achieving over 95% purity at a pilot or industrial scale.

prev.basis: its proprietary protein purification platform requiring merely one to three steps to yield maximum purity
